task_text: Convert top-of-atmosphere multispectral imagery to surface reflectance by correcting atmospheric scattering and absorption.
Apply a complete atmospheric correction to satellite imagery and return analysis-ready surface-reflectance bands.
Derive surface reflectance from top-of-atmosphere observations using an atmospheric radiative correction workflow.
Fit a polynomial temporal trend to every raster cell in an image time series and output the trend model results.
Model nonlinear change through time by applying polynomial regression across a raster time series.
Create spatial outputs of polynomial trend coefficients from a sequence of time-indexed rasters.
Identify the most important locations in the study area for intervention and return the final priority zones.
Determine which parts of the region should receive the highest conservation priority.
Select the best areas for a new public-service investment and produce a recommended site layer.
Find the meaningful spatial clusters in the observation layer and return the cluster result.
Identify the spatial concentrations that should count as hotspots in the dataset.
Group the mapped observations into their natural spatial patterns and produce the resulting groups.
